test_title: PYST 6: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 03 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
A sentence has been given with a blank to be filled with an appropriate option. Choose the correct alternative.

Potato milk is ________ another option for those wanting an alternative to cow's milk.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 2'** i.e.** 'yet'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the **blank needs a word that can*** introduce an addition or an alternative,* which is exactly what **'yet**' does. 

Therefore, the** completed sentence** would be:* "Potato milk is **yet** another option for those wanting an alternative to cow's milk."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **'Though'** is not suitable because it is used to introduce a contrast or contradiction, not an addition.
 
• **'So' **is used to introduce a result or effect, not an addition.
 
• **'But'** is used to introduce a contrast or exception, not an addition
